dedupe_keys.name: droop control aided state estimation and false data detection in active distribution systems

description: The model incorporates renewable-generator droop-control equations into the distribution-system state-estimation optimisation problem. The 2025 paper evaluates accuracy, observability and random or sophisticated false-data resilience on two real medium-voltage systems, against conventional weighted least squares. An earlier 2024 paper by the same core authors describes the same droop-integrated estimation method on one medium-voltage system. Both are grouped as a method family, preserving the later cyberattack evaluation and different study coverage; exact code version equivalence is unknown. The source authors provide the native description and file descriptors through Zenodo. Only metadata was inspected; no measurements, archives, source code or document bodies were retrieved. Public access and the deposit document licence do not establish executable access, software reuse rights or operating costs. Coverage remains bounded to the named experiments, with other geographic and temporal fields unknown. Related project resources may overlap; common project membership does not establish identical simulation inputs or results.
name: Droop-Control-Aided State Estimation and False Data Detection in Active Distribution Systems
